■ Activates when using Burst Skill as long as this unit is still alive. Affects all allies.
Proportionally shares damage taken. This effect is continuous.
DEF ▲ {1}% of the skill user's DEF continuously.
■ Activates when performing a Full Charge attack. Affects all allies (except self).
Restores HP equal to {2}% of the skill user's final max HP.

自分を除く味方全体に
